business_problem: Pyramid Analytics wanted non-technical business users to get answers and visualizations from distributed enterprise data without waiting on overburdened data teams or learning specialist tools.
solution_summary: Pyramid Analytics extended its GenBI product with IBM watsonx.ai to let business users request sophisticated analytics in natural language. The company’s customers often had data scattered across multiple repositories and represented differently in each system, which meant report requests queued up with technical teams and insight arrived too late for many decisions. By adding watsonx.ai to the stack, Pyramid built a natural-language layer that can interpret ambiguous user intent, map it to analytic needs and generate relevant insights and visualizations in seconds. IBM workshops and Build Lab collaboration accelerated the early design and implementation. The resulting architecture brings generative AI close to enterprise data while remaining deployable in private environments, so organizations can democratize analytics access without sending sensitive data into uncontrolled public workflows.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Understands user intent expressed in natural language and generates analytics outputs and visualizations.

data_flow: Business users submit natural-language questions, watsonx.ai interprets the request against distributed enterprise data and the GenBI application returns analytics outputs and visualizations without waiting for manual report creation.
integration_points: Private cloud or on-premises deployment environments
business_outcome: Pyramid reduced the time from business question to actionable insight, widened access to analytics and created a foundation for secure generative BI inside customer environments.
architecture_clues: Designed to be LLM-agnostic but implemented with watsonx.ai
Can run on-premises or in a private cloud
Generates both insights and data visualizations from natural-language requests
evidence_quotes: That’s why we created Generative Business Intelligence (GenBI): a revolutionary AI-powered solution that allows non-technical users to describe their analytics needs in their own words and get insights and data visualizations for sophisticated requests within seconds.
The capabilities of IBM watsonx™ to understand natural language, whether it’s written or spoken, enable Pyramid to interpret user intent.
The result is that users benefit from an expert data analyst who’s available 24 hours a day and can respond to even the most complicated questions in under 30 seconds.
